title: Kaptein benchmark result
description: A single recorded benchmark run (one file per commit/release, written by scripts/bench-record.sh). Metric names are stable across releases so results stay comparable.

git_sha.description: The commit the run was recorded against.

host.description: Optional host/runner identifier for cross-machine comparison.

metrics.description: Flat map of stable metric name to number (units encoded in the name).
